subject: Cloud Marketplace technical evidence + co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@dataforge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@dataforge.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Cloud Marketplace technical evidence + co-sell readiness

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Thanks again for the intro last week. DataForge is ready to start the AWS Marketplace listing flow and we want to understand what technical artifacts Redwood needs to sign off on the listing and to enable co-sell engagement with AWS.

High level: we plan to list a SaaS offering (hosted by DataForge) that integrates with Redwood via the inference API. AWS engineering asked for the following examples of evidence: SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, deployment manifest (container/Helm or AMI), architecture diagram, and a test account for a short canary run. We attached our vendor_profile.docx and a quick cloud-arch-diagram.png to this first email.

Can you confirm who on your side owns:
- Marketplace listing owner / publisher contact
- Technical reviewer for the integration artifacts
- Legal contact for the DPA and co-sell paperwork

We'd like to get a go/no-go within two weeks if possible (target: April 25).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if useful.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships, DataForge Consulting
Attachments: vendor_profile.docx, cloud-arch-diagram.png
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@dataforge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Marketplace technical evidence + co-sell readiness

Elena — thanks for the details and for the attachments. Copying Karthik and Laura to route the ask to the right teams.

Short answers:
- Marketplace listing owner: Laura will shepherd the publisher listing and HubSpot record.
- Technical reviewer: Karthik (platform partnerships) will take the lead on the artifact checklist.
- Legal/DPA: I'll loop in our contracts team once we have the final listing scope; for the initial evidence we typically need the SOC 2 cover letter and the data flow diagram.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to share Redwood's marketplace evidence template (one-off) and a short checklist so you can map your artifacts.
2) Laura to open the HubSpot opportunity for co-sell and share the DocuSign DPA link when ready.
3) Quick 30-minute sync early next week to align timelines.

Is April 20 workable for you to deliver the artifacts? If not, let me know the realistic earliest date.

Marcus Lin
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/DF-8921

I'll also add our partner PM (partners@dataforge.com) to any calendar invites you create.

—Elena

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud Marketplace technical evidence + co-sell readiness

Elena / Marcus — great, thanks for the quick turn. I've attached Redwood's marketplace-evidence-template.xlsx and a listing-template.md that we use to generate the AWS listing copy. Please map your artifacts to column A and populate the status column (ready / in progress / missing).

A few specific asks from our side so the AWS partner-engagement can move smoothly:
- SOC 2: summary/attestation PDF (we don't need the full report initially, just the auditor letter + scope)
- Data flow diagram: high-level showing what data leaves DataForge and what calls Redwood's inference API, plus any PII flow notes
- Technical: Helm chart or AMI manifest + a short README for smoke-test steps (Karthik will run smoke tests against the sandbox API key)
- Commercial: proposed pricing tier and whether you want dealer-style co-sell revenue split or referral model (we'll surface with AWS)
- DPA: please sign the DocuSign when I send — we need that before production listing.

I'll create the HubSpot opportunity today (DF-8921) and send a DocuSign envelope for the DPA. Can we aim for a 30-minute technical sync on Thursday, Apr 15 at 10:00 AM PT?

Attachments: marketplace-evidence-template.xlsx, listing-template.md

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partner Programs Manager — Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <esoto@dataforge.com>

Laura — thanks, I received the templates and the HubSpot link. We'll populate the spreadsheet and upload the artifacts to the Drive folder by April 20.

A couple of notes:
- We'll provide the SOC 2 auditor letter and a short README for the Helm chart.
- The sandbox API key will be available by April 14 so Karthik can run smoke tests; I'll email the key and sandbox endpoints once they're ready.
- On commercial model: DataForge prefers a referral-style arrangement initially; we'll include proposed pricing and margins in the spreadsheet.

I'll accept the DocuSign envelope as soon as Laura sends it. Please go ahead and schedule the technical sync for Apr 15 — our PM will join.

Appreciate the quick cadence — excited to get this live.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Partnerships, DataForge Consulting
Attachments referenced: none (artefacts to follow)
